Subject: Joint integration demo & planning — time windows + prep

Hi all —

Thanks for your interest in a group walkthrough to compare integration patterns and run a short Q&A on infra/permissions. To be respectful of calendars, proposing three short windows (30–40m) next week — we'll run a ~20m joint demo followed by 10–20m of breakout Q&A if you want deeper follow-ups.

Proposed windows (PDT):
- Tue 2026-06-15 16:00–16:40 (APAC-friendly start)
- Wed 2026-06-16 09:00–09:40 (EMEA-friendly)
- Wed 2026-06-16 15:00–15:40 (US west)

Agenda (attached): joint_demo_agenda.pdf. Please reply with preferred window(s) or propose an alternate time; if there are internal stakeholders we should include from your side, add them to the reply.

We anticipate: overview (Redwood runtime + routing), demo of model routing and KV-cache for multi-tenant flows, short security touchpoint (SOC2/retention), and breakout rooms for vertical-specific questions.

Attachments: attendee_list.csv (placeholder for headcount), joint_demo_agenda.pdf
Calendly: https://calendly.com/redwood/joint-integration-demo-30m

Thanks —
Sergio

Wed 15:00 PDT would work best for us, though we might need to hop off early (have another customer sync at 15:30). If it's possible to record the breakout and share notes, that would be great.

Also: could we carve a short vertical-specific breakout for data-sync architecture (we're very concerned about burst throughput from our ETL jobs)? If so, can we add Alex Chen (alex.chen@aptora.com) to the thread — he's our infra lead.
